description: Give a session opening in an unprimed repository the layout earlier sessions already discovered, and tell the agent what a prompt leaves unstated.

hooks.command: command -v pitwall >/dev/null 2>&1 && pitwall hook WorktreeCreate || echo '{}'
command -v pitwall >/dev/null 2>&1 && pitwall hook UserPromptSubmit || echo '{}'
command -v pitwall >/dev/null 2>&1 && pitwall hook SessionStart || echo '{}'
